Why SeedBlink

## One platform. Complete lifecycle. Europe’s venture standard.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/663a17fd3c305cdbcb754344/684bd50b05b0177e7a79acc3_icon%20grow%20seedblink%202.svg)

###### The only integrated infrastructure

Not another point solution. Primary investments, secondaries, equity management, and deal coordination - all connected in one platform.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/663a17fd3c305cdbcb754344/696f4d20a534d77e16a7abef_globe%20icon%20blue.svg)

###### Built for European complexity

Cross-border by design. Investment vehicles that work across jurisdictions. EU-regulated and ESMA registered.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/663a17fd3c305cdbcb754344/696f4d1fc6517c185acd8c2d_zoom-in%20icon%20blue.svg)

###### Battle-tested at scale

80M+ capital under administration. 200+ deals. Real infrastructure managing real capital across European markets.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/663a17fd3c305cdbcb754344/684bd50be851dc18892d9cba_icon%20grow%20seedblink%201.svg)

###### Network effects you can't replicate

110.000+ members, 6.500+ companies. The ecosystem feeds itself - companies attract investors, investors discover companies.

SeedBlink Legal - By Andrei Hancu Law Office

## Legal that’s wired into every stage of the venture lifecycle

Not a standalone service - a legal practice structurally embedded in SeedBlink’s infrastructure, built from 150+ deals inside the platform. Legal design principles and AI-powered workflows, serving founders and investors at every stage.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/663a17fd3c305cdbcb754344/69cb7e815294f782e2364a5b_Icon%20glass%20fundraising.svg)

Fundraising
